<\STATESEP>section "Displaying Phantom Types for Word Operations"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Type_Syntax
  imports "HOL-Library.Word"
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>ML \<open>
structure Word_Syntax =
struct

  val show_word_types = Attrib.setup_config_bool @{binding show_word_types} (K true)

  fun tr' cnst ctxt typ ts = if Config.get ctxt show_word_types then
      case (Term.binder_types typ, Term.body_type typ) of
        ([\<^Type>\<open>word S\<close>], \<^Type>\<open>word T\<close>) =>
          list_comb
            (Syntax.const cnst $ Syntax_Phases.term_of_typ ctxt S $ Syntax_Phases.term_of_typ ctxt T
            , ts)
        | _ => raise Match
  else raise Match

end
\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>syntax
  "_Ucast" :: "type \<Rightarrow> type \<Rightarrow> logic" ("(1UCAST/(1'(_ \<rightarrow> _')))")<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>translations
  "UCAST('s \<rightarrow> 't)" => "CONST ucast :: ('s word \<Rightarrow> 't word)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>typed_print_translation
  \<open> [(@{const_syntax ucast}, Word_Syntax.tr' @{syntax_const "_Ucast"})] \<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>syntax
  "_Scast" :: "type \<Rightarrow> type \<Rightarrow> logic" ("(1SCAST/(1'(_ \<rightarrow> _')))")<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>translations
  "SCAST('s \<rightarrow> 't)" => "CONST scast :: ('s word \<Rightarrow> 't word)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>typed_print_translation
  \<open> [(@{const_syntax scast}, Word_Syntax.tr' @{syntax_const "_Scast"})] \<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>syntax
  "_Revcast" :: "type \<Rightarrow> type \<Rightarrow> logic" ("(1REVCAST/(1'(_ \<rightarrow> _')))")<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>translations
  "REVCAST('s \<rightarrow> 't)" => "CONST revcast :: ('s word \<Rightarrow> 't word)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>typed_print_translation
  \<open> [(@{const_syntax revcast}, Word_Syntax.tr' @{syntax_const "_Revcast"})] \<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
